implemented.database_selection: Explicit caller-selected create or open; no missing-store replacement
implemented.lifetime_capacity: Immutable 1..64 rows; cancellation and uncertainty consume slots
implemented.transaction: Strict writes, resolve on completion, cross-tab serialization
implemented.records: Bounded validated certificate/gateway history and snapshotted inputs
implemented.fixture: Same maintained owner; test-only IndexedDB transaction-abort injection

covers: missing-store reopen refuses without creating an empty database
existing-store creation and changed capacity refuse
caller and returned-row mutation cannot alter retained binding
competing tabs cannot claim the same certificate twice
origin/body bounds refuse before changing history
uncertainty, non-2xx, repeat URL, observation mismatch and byte budget refuse
cancelled rows retain full lifetime capacity
graceful browser-process restart retains exact cancellation and gateway history
new gateway execution owner refuses after restart
deliberately corrupted earlier gateway history refuses

certificate_gateway.covers: IC-signed issuance/read-state, competing tabs, reload, cancelled/lost replies, actual aborted claim/observation transactions and bounded SDK gateway effects
certificate_gateway.provider: Local gateway and host-fact substitutes only

failures.cause: Extra fixture slot inputs overflowed the deliberate u128::MAX operation; store correctly refused malformed operation
failures.correction: Bounded modulo-u128 fixture identities only; no production allocation or retry rule changed

limitations: Graceful Chromium restart only; power loss, eviction, profile rollback and hostile same-origin scripts unqualified
Application authentication and actual trial profile/origin/database remain unselected
Journal validates structure; certificate transport still owns envelope/signature/request binding
No deployed gateway, provisioning, provider economics, retention or billing observation
No full CI, Rust rebuild, release/version mutation, publication or sibling edits
cleanup: No build cleanup; controlled test browser profiles retained under .tmp, no external obligations
